[SWS_Can_00384] ⌈Each time the CAN controller state machine is triggered with the
state transition value CAN_CS_STARTED, the function Can_SetControllerMode
shall re-initialize the CAN controller with the same controller configuration set previ-
ously used by functions Can_SetBaudrate or Can_Init.⌋
Refer to [SWS_Can_00048] for the case of a wakeup event from CAN bus occurred
during sleep transition.
